# Sources

Copied from https://github.com/yama6a/subtitle-toolbox-php/tree/c0adecd5375820d5313f1583fc7e67942d514600/tests/files/mpsub, MIT. In the rows below, "this repository" means subtitle-toolbox-php.

| File | Source | License |
|:--- |:--- |:--- |
| `valid.mpsub` | Written for this repository. Expected `MpSubFormatter` output with `FORMAT=TIME` for `srt/valid.srt`, with the PHP `NOTE` line. The Go tests swap that line for the Go default | MIT |
| `valid_25fps.mpsub` | Written for this repository. Expected `MpSubFormatter` output with `FORMAT=25` for `srt/valid.srt`, with the PHP `NOTE` line. The Go tests swap that line for the Go default | MIT |
| `frames.mpsub` | Written for this repository. Frame-based times with `FORMAT=25` and header lines | MIT |
